page.overview:
What is Task Force 99's Sentinel-class landing craft?

A Sentinel-class landing craft was utilized by Task Force 99, also known as SCAR Squadron, an elite stormtrooper squad of the Galactic Empire. SCAR Squadron, led by Sergeant Kreel, used the Sentinel-class landing craft to travel to the moon Hubin, where prominent Rebel Alliance members Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, and Han Solo, were in hiding; the squad had learned of their location after capturing and interrogating rebel associate and smuggler Sana Starros aboard the shuttle. During a skirmish on the moon, the shuttle was stolen by the rebels, who used it to escape Hubin along with the resident Clan Markona, led by Thane Markona's daughter, Tula. The rebels traveled in the Sentinel-class landing craft to the Imperial Impound Yard on Novka, where Starros' starship, Volt Cobra, had been taken. After crashing the shuttle through a control tower, the rebels escaped aboard the Volt Cobra while Markona and her clan commandeered another vessel.

A shuttle, the Sentinel-class landing craft was equipped with engines and a hyperdrive. The starship also possessed a transponder that could be damped to obscure its identity. Able to be flown by one pilot and a navigator, the shuttle could accommodate a number of passengers. The shuttle had a red stripe on the front of its cockpit exterior, while its viewport appeared red from the outside.

During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, the Sentinel-class landing craft was utilized by Task Force 99, an elite Imperial stormtrooper squad also known as SCAR Squadron, led by Sergeant Kreel. SCAR Squadron caught her attempting to evade an Imperial Star Destroyer. The squad interrogated Starros using a torture droid aboard the shuttle, learning the rebels' location.

SCAR Squadron landed the vessel on Hubin, within the village inhabited by the resident Clan Markona. Upon landing, they were greeted by Thane Markona, who led them back to his estate while trooper Aero secured the ship. The squad intended to capture the rebels and take them to their shuttle, but Markona, citing the tradition of Hubin and the fact that the rest of the clan would retaliate and prevent the stormtroopers from returning to their ship if they harmed him or the settlement, instead arranged a duel between Kreel and Skywalker.
